6495-7084-8293.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-7084-8293.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

455-2226-2397.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
455-2226-2397.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama (and up to two other target creatures) to their owners' hands.
Repeat.

1417-4279-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7864-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

147-5929-8199.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Brigid's Command
147-5929-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brigid's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Brigid's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5929-8199.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6965-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-6965-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4213-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
4213-4687-5479.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1479-2692-2841-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2692-2841-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7768-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1987-2020-6991.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2539-3094-4659-7060-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-7060-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1074-2113-4222.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

2893-3470-4826-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4452-6791.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4017-4186-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4186-6097.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3946-5450-6701.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

5478-5531-5732-6620.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
5478-5531-5732-6620.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

74-617-2593.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Astral Cornucopia.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-2438-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-2438-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

116-1432--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
116-1432--80.description:
If Kiora's Follower is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Kiora's Follower to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower and another legendary creature.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

5532-5641.notablePrerequisites:
Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
5532-5641.description:
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1374-3480-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3480-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

129-3772-4019.notablePrerequisites: Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
129-3772-4019.description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Kinnan triggers, adding {C} or {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.

915-1283-2722.notablePrerequisites: Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
915-1283-2722.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery and Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.

539-1003-1479-2232-3585.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
The Badger enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Kodama.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

549-1030-2034-4853.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
549-1030-2034-4853.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Othelm.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

873-1528-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
873-1528-5195.description:
Cast Twiddle by paying {U}, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Twiddle targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
 Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Twiddle, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Repeat from step 3.

1283-1987-2510-2556.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1283-1987-2510-2556.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
